definitions.demand: Annual distributed electricity within a harmonized modeling region (GWh).
definitions.supply: Annual local electricity generation within the same harmonized region (GWh).

data_treatment.year_2016: Interpolated in modeling history only; not an observed validation target.
data_treatment.other_missing: Preserved as missing; never converted to zero.
data_treatment.population: Backlog; not integrated into the production dashboard data contract.
data_treatment.ruptl: Benchmark and scenario reference only; not a production target.

accounting_disclaimer: This accounting difference compares local generation with distributed electricity. Interregional electricity flows are omitted, so it must not be interpreted as shortage, surplus, or adequacy.
